Trees are falling sick, one at a time, along the river, and nobody knows why. The people she answers to want it found. In 4E 48 the An-Xileel, who ruled then, used the mad Hist of Lilmoth to call down the flying city Umbriel, and its dead killed Lilmoth's people. The Xeech-Leel made the Toh-Reel-Ka so that no tree, and nobody allied with a tree, can ever turn on the marsh like that again. They comb the work gangs for strangers with no kin and no ties, because such a stranger makes a useful spy and a cheap one; she chose the player off the barge's list. Nobody in the marsh is owed a reason. They pay, and they give work. She gives the player fifty gold and asks them to come back to her, here, for a second task. Does: sets stage 90. Checks: nothing.
